name: observability-strategy
description: Design observability strategy across three pillars (metrics / logs / traces) plus events + profiles. Tool selection (Prometheus+Grafana / Datadog / New Relic / Honeycomb / OpenTelemetry native / ELK / Loki / Tempo / Jaeger / Pyroscope). Structured logging standard, metric naming + cardinality, distributed tracing with OTel, alerting philosophy (on SLO burn, not on symptoms), dashboards per audience. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
